units.title: Ratios and Rates
units.blurb: Compare quantities with ratios, find unit rates and percents, and convert units.

units.title: Fractions, Decimals and Factors
units.blurb: Divide fractions, compute fluently with multi-digit numbers, and use GCF and LCM.

units.title: Negative Numbers
units.blurb: Place positive and negative numbers on lines and grids, compare them, and find absolute value.

units.title: Expressions
units.blurb: Use exponents and variables, write and evaluate expressions, and make equivalent expressions.

units.title: Equations and Inequalities
units.blurb: Check solutions, solve one-step equations, and write inequalities.

units.title: Area, Surface Area and Volume
units.blurb: Find areas of triangles and polygons, surface area from nets, and volume with fractional edges.

units.title: Statistics
units.blurb: Ask statistical questions and describe data by its center, spread and shape.

topics.title: Ratios
topics.short: A ratio compares two quantities, like 3 cups of flour for every 2 cups of milk.
topics.trouble: Students reverse the order of a ratio, or mix up part-to-part and part-to-whole ratios.

topics.title: Equivalent Ratios and Ratio Tables
topics.short: Multiply both quantities by the same number to keep the ratio.
topics.trouble: Students add the same amount to both quantities, thinking 2:3 equals 4:5.

topics.title: Graphing Ratios
topics.short: Pairs from a ratio table lie on a straight line through (0, 0).

topics.title: Unit Rates
topics.short: Find how much for one: 120 miles in 3 hours is 40 miles per hour.
topics.trouble: Students divide in the wrong order and get hours per mile when miles per hour is asked.

topics.title: Unit Price and Constant Speed
topics.short: Use unit rates to compare prices and find time or distance.

topics.title: Percent Means per 100
topics.short: 35% means 35 out of every 100.
topics.trouble: Students think 0.5% is the same as 50%.

topics.title: Finding a Percent of a Number
topics.short: 30% of 80 is 30 hundredths of 80.

topics.title: Finding the Whole from a Part
topics.short: If 12 is 40% of a number, find the number.
topics.trouble: Students multiply 12 by 40% instead of asking what number 12 is 40% of.

topics.title: Converting Units with Ratios
topics.short: Use a ratio like 12 inches : 1 foot to convert.
topics.trouble: Students multiply when they should divide because they do not check which unit is larger.

topics.title: What Dividing by a Fraction Means
topics.short: 3/4 ÷ 1/8 asks how many eighths fit in three fourths.

topics.title: Dividing Fractions
topics.short: Multiply by the reciprocal of the divisor, and see why it works.
topics.trouble: Students flip the first fraction, or both, instead of the divisor.

topics.title: Fraction Division Word Problems
topics.short: Solve sharing and measuring problems with fractions.

topics.title: Long Division Fluency
topics.short: Divide multi-digit numbers with the standard algorithm.

topics.title: Decimal Operations Fluency
topics.short: Add, subtract, multiply and divide multi-digit decimals.

topics.title: Greatest Common Factor and Least Common Multiple
topics.short: Find the GCF and LCM of two numbers.
topics.trouble: Students mix up which one they need, using the LCM to split items into equal groups.

topics.title: Factoring a Sum with the GCF
Positive and Negative Numbers
topics.short: Use signs for opposite directions: above and below zero, gains and losses.

topics.title: Opposites
topics.short: −3 and 3 are the same distance from 0 on opposite sides; −(−3) = 3.

topics.title: Rational Numbers on the Number Line
topics.short: Place numbers like −2.5 and −3/4 on a number line.
topics.trouble: Students place −2.5 between −2 and −1, reading the line right to left like positive numbers.

topics.title: Ordering Rational Numbers
topics.short: Farther left is less, so −8 < −3.
topics.trouble: Students say −8 is greater than −3 because 8 is greater than 3.

topics.title: Absolute Value
topics.short: |−5| = 5 is the distance from 0.
topics.trouble: Students mix up order and size, thinking a debt of −30 is "less debt" than −10.

topics.title: The Four-Quadrant Coordinate Plane
topics.short: Plot points with negative coordinates and reflect across the axes.
topics.trouble: Students plot (−3, 2) at (2, −3), or think (0, 4) lies on the x-axis.

topics.title: Distance on the Coordinate Plane
topics.short: Find distances between points that share a coordinate.
topics.trouble: Students subtract coordinates with different signs and get a distance that is too small, as from −3 to 4.

topics.title: Whole-Number Exponents
topics.short: 2⁴ means 2 × 2 × 2 × 2.
topics.trouble: Students multiply the base by the exponent, so 2⁴ becomes 8.

topics.title: Order of Operations with Exponents
topics.short: Exponents come before multiplying and dividing.
topics.trouble: Students multiply before applying the exponent, so 3 × 2² becomes 36.

topics.title: What a Variable Stands For
topics.short: A letter stands for a number we do not know yet or that can change.
topics.trouble: Students treat letters as labels, reading 3a as "3 apples" instead of 3 times a number.

topics.title: Writing Expressions with Variables
topics.short: "5 less than n" is n − 5.
topics.trouble: Students translate "5 less than n" as 5 − n.

topics.title: Terms, Coefficients and Factors
topics.short: Name the parts of 2(x + 3) + 4y.

topics.title: Evaluating Expressions and Formulas
topics.short: Substitute numbers for variables and simplify.
topics.trouble: Students read 3x with x = 4 as 34 instead of 3 × 4.

topics.title: Equivalent Expressions with Properties
topics.short: Use the distributive property: 3(x + 2) = 3x + 6.
topics.trouble: Students multiply only the first term, writing 3(x + 2) = 3x + 2.

topics.title: Are These Expressions Equal?
topics.short: y + y + y and 3y are equal for every y.
topics.trouble: Students judge equivalence by checking one value of the variable.

topics.title: Is It a Solution?
topics.short: Substitute to see whether a value makes an equation true.

topics.title: One-Step Equations with Adding and Subtracting
topics.short: Undo adding by subtracting the same amount from both sides.
topics.trouble: Students subtract from one side only, or add when they should subtract.

topics.title: One-Step Equations with Multiplying and Dividing
topics.short: Undo multiplying by dividing both sides by the same number.
topics.trouble: Students subtract the coefficient, solving 4x = 12 as x = 8.

topics.title: Writing Equations for Word Problems
topics.short: Turn a story into a one-step equation and solve it.

topics.title: Inequalities and Their Graphs
topics.short: x > 3 includes every number to the right of 3, but not 3.
topics.trouble: Students use a closed dot for > or read 3 < x as "x is less than 3."

topics.title: Dependent and Independent Variables
topics.short: One quantity changes because of another; show it with tables, graphs and equations.
topics.trouble: Students put the dependent variable on the horizontal axis.

topics.title: Area of a Parallelogram
topics.short: Cut and slide a triangle to make a rectangle: A = bh.
topics.trouble: Students multiply the base by the slanted side instead of the height.

topics.title: Area of a Triangle
topics.short: A triangle is half of a parallelogram: A = ½bh.
topics.trouble: Students forget the ½, or use a side that is not perpendicular to the base.

topics.title: Area of a Trapezoid
topics.short: Two copies make a parallelogram: A = ½(b₁ + b₂)h.

topics.title: Area of Composite Polygons
topics.short: Split a polygon into rectangles and triangles.

topics.title: Polygons on the Coordinate Plane
topics.short: Draw polygons from vertices and find side lengths.

topics.title: Nets and Surface Area
topics.short: Unfold a solid into a net and add the areas of its faces.
topics.trouble: Students miss the hidden faces, or count a face twice.

topics.title: Volume with Fractional Edge Lengths
topics.short: Pack a prism with small cubes to see that V = lwh still works.

topics.title: Statistical Questions
topics.short: A statistical question expects answers that vary.
topics.trouble: Students call "How old am I?" statistical, though it has one answer.

topics.title: Dot Plots and Histograms
topics.short: Show data as dots or as bars over intervals.
topics.trouble: Students leave gaps between histogram bars or use intervals of different widths.

topics.title: The Mean as a Fair Share
topics.short: The mean evens out all values into equal amounts.

topics.title: Median and Mode
topics.short: The median is the middle value of the ordered data.
topics.trouble: Students take the middle value without putting the data in order first.

topics.title: Range and Interquartile Range
topics.short: The IQR is the spread of the middle half of the data.

topics.title: Box Plots
topics.short: Draw a box plot from the five-number summary.
topics.trouble: Students think a longer section of a box plot holds more data points.

topics.title: Mean Absolute Deviation
topics.short: The average distance of the data from the mean.
topics.trouble: Students average the signed differences, which always gives 0.

topics.title: Describing a Distribution
topics.short: Describe the center, spread and shape, and choose mean or median.
topics.trouble: Students report the mean for skewed data with an outlier, where the median describes it better.
